name: robots/andrejorsula__space_robotics_bench
title: Space Robotics Bench _manipulation template (Isaac Sim Gymnasium environment)
intro: Space Robotics Bench _manipulation template (Isaac Sim Gymnasium environment), adapted from andrejorsula/space_robotics_bench. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
